title: The stall alarm names the cause that holds work now, not a launch error from hours ago
description: A fixture install seeds a launch failure for an item that is since done and a back-off whose until passed hours ago, with ready work and a free worker slot. The loop's cycle deletes both entries the same cycle; after the stall the alarm in master status mentions neither and names each ready item's current dispatch gate in plain words — no free worker account, an exclusive resource and its holder — never 'has no actor', and an item parked on a human decision is not reported.

steps.name: the stall alarm in master status names the current gate, never the done item's failure or the expired back-off
